capabilities: Mark recently created and modified files in the file explorer with icon markers
Configure marker shape, color, and position relative to the filename
Style recent file titles with bold, color, or highlight
Set separate hour thresholds for new versus modified files
Set a rescan interval and toggle the marker icon on or off
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian's file explorer gives no visual cue for which notes were recently created or changed, so recent work is hard to spot at a glance.
summary: File recency marker that decorates recently created or modified files in the file explorer with customizable star icons and title styling.
